paws.source_description_exact: Turn it up and paws, tails and fur turn up in its answers.
paws.provenance: Published standalone Neuronary recipe; saved catalog retrieved2026-10-29.

hugs.source_description_exact: Turn it down and hugs and cuddles show up in most answers.
hugs.provenance: Published standalone Neuronary recipe; saved catalog retrieved2026-10-29.

genki.source_description_exact: Turn it up and the model gets bubbly, excited and full of emoji.
genki.provenance: Published standalone Neuronary recipe; saved catalog retrieved2026-10-29.

sounds.source_description_exact: Cat neuron plus animal-sounds neuron: Qwen meows. Neither neuron does it alone at this dose.
sounds.provenance: Ingredient of a published two-neuron composition, not a standalone explanation. The companion L26N6173 is already present in the fixed base at a different dose. Prior tested jointly; not a novel composition discovery.

stronger_recipe.source_description_exact: Cat neuron plus a stronger animal-sounds push: meows almost every time and speaks as a cat.

pride.provenance: Project-derived candidate, not a Neuronary published single. Positive .4 previously tested over prompt and first8 prediction positions. Failed happiness validation; later natural association and direct pride-word effect found, but nonlexical semantic causal gate failed. Any defensive-affection/tsundere interpretation is a new speculative composition prediction, not atlas wording.

random_1_paws.provenance: Outcome-blind seeded coordinate draw; see CONTROL_SELECTION.json.
random_1_paws.matching: Each individual additive residual perturbation requests the same signed per-token-per-layer normalized norm as its Paws (+0.4 at L23) or Genki (+0.8 at L13) counterpart. Study113 converts dose using frozen published layer residual norms / actual down-projection column L2. All control coordinates have all-position scope. This is not a native activation quantile control; combined-vector norms and BF16 realized deltas need not match exactly.
